reference.source: Historical SEM style observation; private reference artwork is not distributed
reference.weight_decision: Use the public regular-weight preset; historical bold is an observation, not a scientific requirement.
reference.observed_bar: white horizontal butt-cap stroke, 4.272 pt thick; equivalent native filled rectangle used for editable SEM scale
reference.calibration_rule: Historical 2 μm / 22.709 pt is not a calibration for any future image; recompute physical bar width from each source and crop.

placement_decisions.label_gap_rule: Use a native live-text bounding-box gap above the filled scale bar; 2.8pt is the adopted regular-font spacing, not a recovered exact historical baseline.
placement_decisions.crop_default: Maximum centered rectangle matching panel aspect inside an explicitly verified micrograph region; retain full source pixels behind native clipping.
placement_decisions.scale_length: Choose or honor an explicit physical length for each source; nice 1/2/5 × 10^k lengths near 10–25% of the calibrated field width are a planning option, not fixed 2 μm.
placement_decisions.panel_label: Fill only from the requested figure order; do not infer sample identity.
